name: 2 PLAYER Evolution Tycoon 🛸
desc:
tired of playing tycoons alone? grab a friend and build together in 2 Player Evolution Tycoon! 💵

start in the Caveman Era 🦴 , upgrade your base, unlock powerful gear, and evolve all the way into a futuristic space world!!!! 🚀

🤝 team up with a friend
🏗️ build and evolve your base
⚔️ unlock new weapons and upgrades
🌎 discover new eras

like the game too for more bases! 😁👍
AND THE GAME SAVES PROGRESS! 💾😊
